dedupeText: vintage cinematic farewell album cover sepia 1940s style military uniform kissing couple railway station red banner condensed sans serif vintage photography warm sepia photography vs vibrant flat red graphic elements verticality of the couple and railway poles vs horizontal text banners soft photographic grain vs sharp vector like text edges combine a nostalgic period specific monochrome photograph with bold modernist flat color graphic blocks and condensed sans serif type to create a past meets present editorial look

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, sepia-toned vintage photograph of a couple in a deep embrace at a railway station, framed by bold, flat red rectangular banners containing stark white condensed typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm sepia photography vs. vibrant flat red graphic elements
Verticality of the couple and railway poles vs. horizontal text banners
Soft photographic grain vs. sharp vector-like text edges
coreInvariants: Solid red rectangular blocks for text placement

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The couple is centrally positioned, captured from the waist up, dominating the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red banner in the top-left corner acts as the primary entry point for the eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the top-left red banner, down the embrace of the couple, to the bottom red banner containing the secondary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The railway tracks on the right and the industrial building on the left provide atmospheric depth and negative space.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red blocks contrasts with the low-saturation, mid-value photographic background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to sepia, red, white, and black

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the base of the composition

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and widths for consistency.
graphicDevices: Stepped red block at the bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, industrial feel of the primary text.
Provides the necessary clean, condensed uppercase look for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, sepia-toned 1940s-style photograph of a man in a military trench coat and officer cap kissing a woman in a dark coat. The setting is a railway station with tracks on the right and a blurred industrial building on the left. The shot is a medium close-up from behind the man's shoulder.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a solid red rectangle in the top-left corner. Inside it, place large, white, extra-condensed sans-serif text in all caps. Add a solid red bar across the bottom edge with a small step-up on the right side. Inside this bar, place medium-sized, white, condensed sans-serif text in all caps, right-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the photograph sepia-toned and grainy?
Are the red boxes solid and vibrant?
Is the text white and condensed?
Is the couple the central focus?

mustRedesign: Any modern clothing or technology in the photo
Gradient fills in the red boxes

mustAchieve: High legibility of white text against red
avoid: Modern digital sharpness in the photo

postGenerationChecks: Check for proper sepia color balance
Ensure red blocks are perfectly rectangular and flat
Verify text is all-caps and condensed
Confirm the period-accurate look of the military uniform
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a nostalgic, period-specific monochrome photograph with bold, modernist flat-color graphic blocks and condensed sans-serif type to create a 'past-meets-present' editorial look.
